image-001 (overview, face 1): single paper/parchment leaf, upright. One column of text, c. 44-45 lines of main text in a small cursive/bastard Gothic book hand, brown ink. Vertical crease/tear running down the centre of the leaf. Upper margin carries three lines of later/different-hand notes (cursive, faint) plus a fourth line (also cursive, partly struck/obscured at its start). Red rubrics: one at line 3 of the main text ("de emptione agrorum ..." type heading) and one c. two-thirds down ("De hereditatibus et domibus vendendis"), each in red ink set at the end of the line where the previous section ends. After each rubric the next section starts indented (hanging layout: first lines of a new section begin further right, as if space left for an initial never filled). A marginal paragraph mark/bracket on the left at line 1 and a large bracket at c. line 20 ("Idem"). Left margin: a "7" (? folio/quire number) in blue/grey near top. Grey redaction boxes (modern library labels masked) at upper left and lower left. Bottom right corner damaged/torn. Paper strip/repair at the foot near the centre.
Tentative: technical prose text (questions on buying land, houses), sectioned by rubrics; no commentary/gloss layout visible.

Face 1 tiles: image-002 (top), -003, -004, -005 (bottom), each the full width of the leaf; vertical overlap between neighbours.
